Package io.vanslog.spring.data.meilisearch.repository.support

Class SimpleReactiveMeilisearchRepository<T,ID>

java.lang.Object
io.vanslog.spring.data.meilisearch.repository.support.SimpleReactiveMeilisearchRepository<T,ID>
Type Parameters:
T - the document type
ID - the document identifier type
All Implemented Interfaces:
ReactiveMeilisearchRepository<T,ID>, ReactiveCrudRepository<T,ID>, ReactiveSortingRepository<T,ID>, Repository<T,ID>
public class SimpleReactiveMeilisearchRepository<T,ID> extends Object implements ReactiveMeilisearchRepository<T,ID>
Reactive CRUD implementation backed by cold ReactiveMeilisearchOperations publishers.
